But in justice to myself I must add, that the edition does not pretend to any" critical exposition, and nothing should be expected from it but just what it assumes to be-an eclectic text compiled from five MSS., retaining 911. ४116 errors of the MSS. where no single MS. gives a correct version, and never attempting to decide which is correct and which is wxong, except in a few occasional foot-notes, which may be taken for what they are worth,-in short to give the substance of five MSS., and "not to sit in judgment on them. For a first edition of a littleknown and scarce work this was deemed the safest course.
